{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop refunded orders
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Print unique revenue values in completed orders to verify
print(f'Unique revenue values in completed orders: {completed_only["revenue"].unique()}')"}
